  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 25px;
  border: none;
  background: none;

  font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;

button::before {
  margin-left: auto;

button::after, button::before {
  content: '';
  width: 0%;
  height: 2px;
  background: #f44336;
  display: block;
  transition: 0.5s;
}
